# Route economics (generated by `models/route_economics.py`, v1.2, 2026-10-12)

**Read this first.** Prices, win rates and hours are **ASSUMPTIONS** anchored to published comparables (Claude Code workshops from $900/day and €890 per person for 2 days [S129][S128]; LLM security audits $6k–$45k+, specialist floor ~$16k [S130]; Upwork AI-related work +22% YoY [S127]). No customer has been asked. Revenue is net of VAT. Latvian VAT on Latvian clients is a pass-through, not income. Take-home pay uses simplified 2026 Latvian rules [S100][S123][S124][S125] and is **not tax advice**.

Admin overhead assumed 6 owner-hours/month in all routes. Opportunity-cost benchmarks: mean gross hourly earnings of professionals 2022 — Latvia €13.04, EU27 €24.4 [S126]; approximate **net** Latvian equivalent €8.69/h after 10.5% employee contributions and 25.5% PIT [S100] (CALCULATION). Take-home figures below are net, so compare them with €8.69/h — and, above all, with **your own** net employment or contracting rate (UNKNOWN).

**Cases (revised after independent commercial review):** *base* = a newcomer without track record or warm network; *high* = an owner with a network or strong public proof; *low* = adverse. The combined adverse case also adds 3 months of ramp and +5 percentage points of marketplace fee.
